previous_statement: With Y=(Y_i) and V=(V_i), rectangular matrix multiplication and the coordinate identities of node 1.3.1 yield only Y^dagger dot V=sum_i(Y_i^dagger dot V_i)=sum_i(<Y_i,V_i>*u_Q)=(sum_i<Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q. The presently allowed definitions do not identify sum_i<Y_i,V_i> with the separately named amplified form <Y,V>_n: replacing that level-n form by 2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i> preserves every registered input but changes the claimed equality. Hence the former assertion <Y,V>_n*u_Q, and therefore the claimed deduction of nodes 1.3.2 and 1.3 from this step, is not justified unless the canonical coordinate-sum normalization of the amplified form is added as an allowed definition or validated dependency.
new_statement: Writing Y=(Y_i) and V=(V_i), rectangular matrix multiplication gives Y^dagger dot V=sum_i Y_i^dagger dot V_i. By validated node 1.3.1, each summand is <Y_i,V_i>*u_Q. The registered column-hilbert-corner definition explicitly defines the amplified form by <Y,V>_n=sum_i <Y_i,V_i>. Hence Y^dagger dot V=(sum_i <Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q=<Y,V>_n*u_Q; suppressing the amplification subscript gives the identity required in node 1.3.2.
